surat.headline: Mixed signals for Surat as diamond exports surge despite fraud and operational disruptions.
what_changed: Polished diamond exports saw an October boost driven by Diwali timing, with LGD exports surging 96% and natural diamonds growing 19%.
Textile input costs eased as Polyester FDY prices fell by 6.96% and staple fibre dropped by 4.33% due to lower crude and freight costs.
Textile units face regulatory and tax uncertainty while demanding machinery duty exemption extensions to avoid a potential 9.74% tax burden.
Multiple fire incidents and fraud cases across local diamond trading and grey fabric sub-segments created localized operational and financial stress.
stress_signals: Broker fraud in Katargam led to a Rs 1.27 crore loss of 1,035.15 carats of polished diamonds [e8488d4182be].
Grey fabric fraud committed by Veer Creation operators resulted in a Rs 43.54 lakh loss for Surat textile traders [e15e6b4c5b22].
Repeated fire incidents disrupted textile operations, including a 32-hour blaze at a textile godown and a factory fire in Sachin GIDC [70735ded426a, 386760347e06, 47888fb89bb1].
improvement_signals: GJEPC reports a 96% surge in LGD exports and a 19% increase in natural diamond exports, supported by favorable Diwali timing [ffee544acb58, c035b432ac20].
Polyester FDY and staple fibre prices dropped by 6.96% and 4.33% respectively, providing raw material cost relief to synthetic textile weavers [b6b6f83da93a].
R&D collaborations between MANTRA, IIT Gandhinagar, and Garden Silk Mills focus on textile innovation and new polymeric yarn development [1afe1286245d, a09df64b91a6].
what_to_watch: Government decisions regarding the demand for a 9.74% machinery duty exemption extension through 2032.
Inventory and property loss assessments from recent fire incidents affecting borrower repayment capabilities in Sachin GIDC and local godowns.
Commercialization timelines and capex clarity on Kira's planned LGD expansion to 750,000 carats monthly.
